title: Russia and China retrieval teams and the gentleman's agreement

tellings.quote: Russia and China have their own retrieval teams of non-human intelligence and they have their own technologies reverse engineered and they're pretty much on par with what we're doing.

plain: Russia and China are said to have their own teams that recover crashed craft of non-human intelligence, and their own technology copied from those craft, roughly on par with what the US has. Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a huge UFO in Indonesia, relays this as something he was told, and it would mean the race to recover such craft is not America's alone.
